title: Choose settlement over motion
summary: Better company teaches the wandering mind how to settle. Return the mind to better company before it scatters again. The emphasis here is choose settlement over motion.
takeaway: Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
lifeApplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.

source.shortMeaning: Better company teaches the wandering mind how to settle.
source.lifeApplication: At the threshold, choose better placement before choosing more movement.

evidence.coreClaim: Better company teaches the wandering mind how to settle.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: bring your searching to holy company and let it cool there.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.
